name: The Call Centre
source:
The Call Centre is a Visual Novel game in which you take the role of a call centre agent on their first day of the job ready to take calls from customers having technical issues. You’ll help identify and solve their problems. Or maybe not.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384440/]Steam[/url]]
